T.title: Israel Tax Authority, 2026 salary deduction booklet, updated April 2026
T.scope: Printed/PDF pp. 1-4 and 10-13 read for publication scope, freeze, reform, earned/unearned bands, separate surtax bases, credit value and limits; selected s.3(i) and one-off-payment rows on p.15. No full-document or final legal acceptance.

G.title: Israel Tax Authority, Know Your Rights and Duties, tax year 2025, published July 2026
G.scope: Selected sections: PDF p.7 refund/online filing; p.8 six-year refund paragraph; pp.21,40,48-49,54,58,84,91; pp.118-120 advances/withholding; pp.139-142 VAT annex. Printed pages are PDF minus 2. This is a research read, not acceptance of all provisions. The 2025 annual-return figures do not prove 2026 figures; VAT annex expressly names January 2026 values.

C.title: Israel Tax Authority Circular 5/2018, distributed payment assets
C.scope: All six pages, including scope, classification, barter, business/mining distinction, VAT and audit evidence. Does not establish FIFO, staking, DeFi or a universal crypto tax rate.

R.title: Israel Tax Authority Circular 4/2026, Form 150
R.scope: Printed/PDF pp. 1-4: scope, conditional annual-return attachment, and section 2.1.2 immigrant/returner reporting cutover. Remaining detailed form sections not accepted.

N.title: National Insurance Institute, self-employed contribution rates
N.scope: Working-age table, January 2026 band/ceiling, age/retirement exceptions and minimum income. Reuses prior independent acceptance of eight insurance figures; current full HTML cached with normal TLS.

P.title: National Insurance Institute, employee contribution rates
P.scope: January 2026 band and ceiling plus column 2 controlling-shareholder working-age table; neighbouring ordinary/other-age employee conditions read. Totals only, not an inferred health split.
